AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE BUILDING PERMIT ORDINANCE OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA FOR THE CLARIFICATION OF REGULATIONS CONCERNING THE CONSTRUCTION OF FOUNDATIONS.

THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, DOES HEREBY ORDAIN AND ENACT IN LAW AS FOLLOWS:

SECTION I: Any owner, authorized agent, or contractor who desires to construct, enlarge, or do alterations to building or structure of which a footing and foundation is required, must install a continuous poured footing with an approved reinforced enclosed supporting foundation of an approved material completely around the exterior perimeter of the building or structure, leaving open only the required ventilation and access openings.

SECTION II: All Ordinances or parts of Ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.

SECTION III: This Ordinance.shall become effective after advertisement in the manner provided by law for a public hearing and upon approval by the City Council of the Town of Pine Mountain, Georgia, at a meeting held this 13th day of January, 1986.
